_README: tdd-pipeline manifest. Copy to the ROOT of the target PROJECT (or subproject) as 'tdd.config.json'.
The harness REFUSES to run without this file -- it never guesses the target or the test command.
For a monorepo, place this at the SUBPROJECT root you want under TDD, NOT the workspace root.
JSON has no comments -- per-key meaning is in _DOC. Unknown keys are ignored.
Prefer ARRAY form for commands so args with spaces/backslashes are safe (no shell splitting).

_DOC.root: abs path, or relative-to-this-file; the project root the suite runs in. '.' = this file's dir.
_DOC.runner: pytest | go | jest | make. Only pytest is fully implemented; others are declared seams.
_DOC.test_cmd: ARRAY argv to run the FULL suite, cwd=root. e.g. ["python","-m","pytest"].
_DOC.smoke_cmd: ARRAY argv for the E2E smoke gate (the L009 check). null = unit-green only (logged, not silent).
_DOC.git_mode: git | worktree | snapshot. Decides how the regression firewall checkpoints/restores.
_DOC.worktree_dir: if git_mode=worktree, the worktree subdir that is the real git work tree.
_DOC.protect: globs NEVER snapshotted or committed (secrets, artifacts). gitignored paths auto-excluded in git mode.
_DOC.contract_source: path to a Validation Contract doc, or 'tests' to treat the existing suite as the contract.
_DOC.test_files_immutable: true => fixer agents may not edit test files (anti-cheat; green via mutating tests is rejected).
_DOC.max_rounds: hard cap on red->green iterations before surfacing 'blocked'.
_DOC.k_no_progress: halt if the failing-set has not shrunk for this many consecutive rounds (anti-spin).
_DOC.flaky_reruns: on a green->red flip, re-run that test this many times in isolation before trusting the regression.
_DOC.state_dir: where .tdd state/report/snapshots are written (relative to root).
_DOC.preflight: path to swarm-verify preflight.py to compose for ground-truth; null = auto-detect; "" = skip.
